in_marathi.name: Devprita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity and Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devprita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi Prita means 'beloved of the Gods'. This name is derived from 'Devi', meaning Goddess, and 'Prita', meaning beloved. It is a name that symbolizes prosperity, strength, and the divine blessings of the Gods.
